title: [GMCP 203.012.06] Operations and evidence: Subscriptions, notifications, progress, and operational messages
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-012-06. Ship inspectable CLI, TUI or API state, configuration validation, bounded metrics/logs/traces, diagnostics, examples, migration and rollback guidance, incident runbooks, and reproducible evidence artifacts. Automate drift detection so a changed dependency or standard invalidates stale proof. Vector outcome: Modern subscriptions/listen filters and acknowledgement metadata work for tools, prompts, resources and resource updates, with bounded fan-out, ordering guarantees, cancellation, reconnect policy, backpressure and authorization re-checks. Progress and operational log notifications correlate to the originating request, obey requested levels and redaction, and never become an unbounded covert channel. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
limitations: Operations and evidence stage (GMCP-203-012-06) verifies inspectable CLI/API state (susi mcp ledger, susi mcp status, server/discover, initialize, subscriptions/listen ack metadata), fail-closed CLI and .susi/config.json max_rpc_body_bytes validation with stderr/stdout stream isolation, bounded subscription/progress/logging metrics and W3C traceparent propagation, deterministic air-gapped drift checks across all 6 pinned VC-203-012 specifications (hash_drift and unfetchable), retained append-only evidence chain integrity, and the operator runbook/migration/rollback guidance in docs/gmcp/contract-203-012.md.

Named VC-203-012 evidence (.agents/gmcp/evidence/VC-203-012.jsonl) and mastery verdict (.agents/roadmap-verdicts/VC-203-012.json) are created and sealed by T-CODEXGMCPROADMAP-99 once requirements 01-06 land because gmcp_mastery_records_are_retained_and_current enforces that every .jsonl file under .agents/gmcp/evidence/ already contains a passing mastery record bound to fn gmcp_vc_203_012_mastery.
